notes.title: Fixed an issue where the trading panel might not open at save points
notes.content: [p]The latest update added some improved sound effects and fixed several bugs. More item types will be introduced in future updates to further enhance the gameplay experience.[/p]

notes.title: About the game not having a launch discount
notes.content: [p][b]Title: About the Launch Discount & A Big Thank You[/b][/p][p]Dear players,[/p][p]First of all, thank you so much for enjoying and purchasing [i]To the Eden[/i]. This is my first time independently developing and self-publishing a game. During the launch, I accidentally missed setting up the launch discount, which means many of you purchased the game at full price. I sincerely apologize for this and truly appreciate your understanding and support.[/p][p]The good news is that the game will participate in [b]Steam’s Autumn Sale[/b] and [b]Winter Sale[/b], where it will be available at [b]40% off[/b]. At that time, you’ll be able to enjoy the game at a lower price.[/p][p]For those of you who have already purchased the game at full price, I want to express my heartfelt thanks. Your support means the world to me and motivates me to continue creating and improving the game.[/p][p]Once again, thank you all for your understanding and for being part of this journey. I look forward to bringing you more updates and surprises in the future![/p][p]— [i]The Developer of To the Eden[/i][/p]
